alWindowsApp.title: AL WINDOWS APP
description: Enterprise mobile app for attendance and workforce management on construction sites.
On-site flow for checkers: QR scanning and manual logging of clock-ins, clock-outs, and meal breaks.
Admin panel with dashboard, shift history, incident calendar, leave requests, digitally signed minutes, site reassignment, overtime, and vacations.
Built with React Native, Expo, TypeScript, expo-router, Zustand, permission-based RBAC, and native integrations. Deployed with EAS Build.
